episodes.name: Special 1 (Magic Beast Mountain): Episode 1 Encounter
episodes.overview: Legend has that it deep within the Magic Beast Mountain range, there exists a treasure that can temporarily boost one's fighting strength significantly. Many cultivators risked their lives by going deep into the mountain. All their efforts were in vain, as no one has ever returned. However, many remain obsessed with the elusive treasure, the Purple Spirit Crystal.

episodes.name: Special 1 (Magic Beast Mountain): Episode 2 Farewell
episodes.overview: While Yun Zhi was removing the Lion King's seal, the relationship between her and Xiao Yan became closer due to the young man's attentive nursing. Perhaps it was because of the seal that the arrogance in Yun Zhi's voice when conversing with Xiao Yan began to gradually fade away. But due to Yun Zhi's negligence, their whereabouts were exposed.

episodes.name: Special 2 (Song of the Desert): Episode 1 A Mirage
episodes.overview: For thousands of years, the war between humans and the Snake people has never ceased. Although the Snake people are fierce, human could always rely on their strength in numbers. The Snake people were finally driven to live in a cruel and desolate place, the Tager Desert. Of course, the fight didn't end there. The conflict between two races just intensified more.

episodes.name: Special 2 (Song of the Desert): Episode 2 Angry Sea, Wild Sand
episodes.overview: Hai Bo Dong, the Ice Emperor accepted a job to find a Snake girl with amnesia in the Tager Desert. He didn't expect to find the person who hired him to be dead at the completion of his job. All the while, they were being pursued by the mysterious Snake warrior, and by the entire Snake clan.

episodes.name: Special 2 (Song of the Desert): Episode 3 Song of the Desert
episodes.overview: The Snake people are a race that adheres to ancient traditions. From one generation to the next, there will always be a Queen named Medusa. They are gifted with extraordinary abilities in order to lead the Snake people, and to resist the invasion of others. This ensured the continued survival of their race. This is why Queen Medusa's name is feared throughout the continent. Every generation of Queen Medusa is born into the world from an egg, where their immense strength continues to be inherited.

episodes.name: Three Year Agreement Ep 01: The Promised Duel
episodes.overview: Breaking an engagement is something that is extremely embarrassing in the Douqi continent. But three years ago, Nalan Yanran enlisted the influence of the Yun Lan Sect and went to the Xiao family to break off the engagement. Making the Xiao family the biggest laughingstock in the Jia Ma kingdom. For the sake of regaining his dignity, Xiao Yan, in much anger, made a three-year pact with Nalan Yanran. During these three years of grueling training, Xiao Yan experienced various adversities and gradually grew throughout the process. He also gained a new appreciation for the Three-Year Agreement. Today, Xiao Yan sets foot in the Misty Cloud Sect as promised whereupon this time will mark the end of his grudge.
